text:
Kirby Dach is having the kind of month that changes a conversation. Six points in his last ten games (2 goals, 4 assists) against 3.6 expected, and his ice time over that stretch is up almost three minutes to 12.8. The Athletic's Arpon Basu called it "an impressive streak", and Habs Eyes on the Prize ran with "Kirby Dach finding his form."

Some caution is fair. The points are running ahead of the chances, and at five on five Montreal has been close to even with him out there, 52% of the expected goals (chance quality). Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking from last season said his game wasn't built on creating offense at five on five. His shooting, 12.5%, is about what his talent range expects, so nothing there looks inflated.

The bigger picture is a third overall pick from 2019, now 25, who has spent years being judged against that number. Evolving-Hockey had him at 0.9 wins above replacement last season, mostly from even-strength offense. A healthy, productive Dach in a bottom-six role is useful whatever comes next, and The Sick Podcast is already framing it as trade value.
